tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Senior Java & Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST and OCC APIs, and in designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations. Proven record in agile teams, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and production support. Strong techno-functional consulting: requirements analysis, user stories, and stakeholder coordination. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with AI-assisted development experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the opportunity to join your team because of your leading position in delivering innovative SAP Commerce solutions. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise that matches the role.

bullets.label: Technical Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, implementing Java/Spring services and OCC REST APIs that power headless storefronts.

bullets.label: Integration Mastery
bullets.text: Built robust PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, and integrated SAP ERP and MDM systems, ensuring seamless product data flow.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Worked in cross-functional agile squads, translating business requirements into user stories, functional specs, and delivering CI/CD-driven releases on Docker/Kubernetes.

bullets.label: AI-enhanced Productivity
bullets.text: Leveraged generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, code generation, testing and documentation, shortening delivery cycles.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_de.hook: Die Möglichkeit, Ihr Team bei der Entwicklung innovativer SAP-Commerce-Lösungen zu unterstützen, begeistert mich. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Implementierung und Optimierung von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich das nötige Fachwissen für diese Position mit.

bullets.label: Technische Expertise
bullets.text: Entwickelte End-to-End-Lösungen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java/Spring und OCC-REST-APIs für headless Storefronts.

bullets.label: Integrationskompetenz
bullets.text: Erstellte robuste PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines über Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders und integrierte SAP ERP sowie MDM-Systeme.

bullets.label: Agile Umsetzung
bullets.text: Arbeitete in internationalen agilen Teams, übersetzte Geschäftsanforderungen in User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und realisierte CI/CD-gestützte Releases mit Docker/Kubernetes.

bullets.label: KI-gestützte Produktivität
bullets.text: Setzte generative KI-Tools ein, um Analyse, Code-Erstellung, Tests und Dokumentation zu beschleunigen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist. Mein frühester Eintrittstermin ist der 16.12.2026. Remote, Hybrid oder Vor Ort in Deutschland sind für mich möglich.

tailoring.why_company: Your company’s reputation for delivering cutting-edge SAP Commerce solutions to global brands, combined with the innovative culture in Vogelheim/Essen, aligns perfectly with my passion for building scalable e-commerce platforms. I am eager to contribute my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help you accelerate digital transformation and exceed customer expectations.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join a forward-thinking team that leads SAP Commerce innovation, where my 5+ years of Hybris experience can drive real business value.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in your SAP Commerce Developer role and would love to discuss how I can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute immediately. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for your team.

Best regards
